decision: resolveMode returns cassette when cassettePath is non-empty, even if hasApiKey is false

decision: AgentSpec.memory is none, window, or kb, and the prompt field is promptTemplateId

decision: when calls and tokens both exceed the budget, foldBudget reports maxCallsPerRound

decision: the MCP drop test sends later spawns to a process that exits immediately
why: a healthy respawn of the same server would succeed, so the failed second attempt has to be forced; the client still spawns again and the test expects 3 spawns

decision: actorStamp returns the id@version string and the prompt hash together
why: later event logs need both pieces, and a new version changes each of them
